text: {"label":"Behavioral Pharmacology and Psychotropic Medication","definition":"Work on behavioral pharmacology as a discipline, covering its methods, training, and regulatory roles, and on how psychotropic and prescription medications affect problem behavior, assessment, and treatment in applied behavior analysis.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Unlike laboratory studies of specific drug effects on schedules or choice, general clinical behavior analysis, or intervention programs, it addresses the discipline itself and medication's role in applied treatment."}
